mapper.select: SELECT tenant.tenant_id, tenant.tenant_code, tenant.display_name, tenant.status, tenant.created_at FROM organization_access.tenant tenant LEFT JOIN organization_access.tenant_lifecycle lifecycle ON lifecycle.tenant_id = tenant.tenant_id WHERE lifecycle.tenant_id IS NULL ORDER BY tenant.tenant_id FOR UPDATE OF tenant

SELECT subject.subject_id, subject.login_name, subject.password_hash, subject.status AS subject_status, subject.version AS subject_version, subject.created_at AS subject_created_at, membership.membership_id, membership.membership_role, membership.status AS membership_status, membership.permission_version, membership.version AS membership_version, membership.created_at AS membership_created_at FROM organization_access.subject_identity subject INNER JOIN organization_access.tenant_membership membership ON membership.subject_id = subject.subject_id WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND subject.subject_id = #{subjectId} FOR UPDATE OF subject, membership
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_access.tenant_lifecycle (tenant_id, tenant_code, display_name, initial_administrator_subject_id, status, version, created_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{tenantCode}, #{displayName}, #{initialAdministratorId}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO organization_access.tenant_lifecycle_outbox (event_id, tenant_id, event_type, lifecycle_status, lifecycle_version, occurred_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{tenantId}, 'TENANT_LIFECYCLE_CHANGED', #{status}, #{version}, #{occurredAt})
